text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: `PD: control-plane-tls-expiry` (severity: critical). Description: multiple private control plane TLS handshakes failing across eu-central region. Incident ID: INC-2026-0518-07. Please ack.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: page triggered for emily.choi (oncall). Escalation in 4m.

emily.choi: acked. jumping on. @marco.chen @sre_lead please join. Notifying eng-runtime.

marco.chen: joining. any telemetry? which customers?

emily.choi: control-plane logs showing repeated `tls: certificate has expired or is not yet valid` from our frontend LB to backend control-plane listeners. Affected customer agents: BetaRetail (vpc: br-prod), FinEdge (vpc: fe-main), and a handful of misc accounts in eu-central.

sre_lead: pulling cert metadata. infra_bot, can you show cert expiry for `controlplane-euc.example.internal`?

infra_bot: cert info for controlplane-euc:
```
Subject: CN=controlplane-euc.internal
Issuer: CN=rdw-internal-ca
Not Before: 2025-05-18T09:00:00Z
Not After : 2026-05-18T09:00:00Z  <-- EXPIRED
```

marco.chen: that's the root cause. cert expired at 09:00Z. Why didn't our monitoring alert on cert expiry?

emily.choi: apparently the cert-monitor job failed during its last run: `JobExit: 137` on 05-17 23:50 UTC. Looks like a kube OOM killed the pod.

eng-runtime: confirming. cert-monitor logs:
```
2026-05-17T23:49:50Z INFO checking certs
2026-05-17T23:49:51Z ERR ko job OOMKilled
```

marco.chen: mitigation plan: 1) rotate TLS certs for eu-central control plane and reload listeners, 2) roll restart frontends gracefully, 3) monitor handshake success and agent re-registers. Who can run the rotation?

emily.choi: I will execute rotation script with oversight from infra. `./scripts/rotate-controlplane-cert --region eu-central --bake 30s`. I'll run on a canary node first.

sre_lead: coordinate with eng-runtime for safe reloads. Do rolling reload with 1 node at a time. No customer action required. Notify customers that we're doing a cert rotation and expected brief control plane reconnections.

customer_ops_bot: automated message to affected customers: "We are performing a control-plane certificate rotation in eu-central. You may see short agent reconnects (<2m). No action required on your side. Updates to follow."

emily.choi: running canary rotation now. output:
```
[2026-05-18T09:07:10Z] rotating cert on cp-euc-01
[2026-05-18T09:07:35Z] issued new cert, reloaded listener
[2026-05-18T09:07:40Z] handshake success with agent 10.20.5.11
```

marco.chen: canary looks good. proceed to roll. I'll run the automation to limit concurrent reloads to 1.

eng-runtime: starting rolling reload across 6 nodes, delay 20s between nodes.

(10m pass)

emily.choi: reload finished. Post-rotation checks: TLS handshake error rate dropped to baseline, agent heartbeat gaps closed, no customer-side changes reported. Sample logs:
```
2026-05-18T09:16:52Z INFO tls handshake completed from 10.4.12.9
2026-05-18T09:17:03Z INFO agent re-registered: BetaRetail-agent-3 last seen 2026-05-18T09:16:59Z
```

sre_lead: good. I'll keep this as active until we've had 30m of stable metrics. Severity: upgraded to sev1 during active outage window, downgrading to sev3 post-mitigation and will close after postmortem.

pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: alert for emily.choi acknowledged at 09:05 UTC. Escalation cancelled.

marco.chen: root cause so far: cert-monitor job OOMKilled causing no early alert on expiring cert; cert expired and frontends rejected TLS, causing agent connections to fail. No customer config change.

emily.choi: adding short-term mitigations: - restart cert-monitor with larger resource requests; - immediate alert rule added: send pager when any control-plane cert expiry <7d; - backfill missing runs for last 7d to ensure no other expiring cert.

eng-runtime: created PR to increase cert-monitor replica resources and add pod anti-affinity. Linking to ticket: INC-2026-0518-07.

customer_ops_bot: FinEdge NOC: "We saw reconnects but no data loss. Thanks for the update." :thumbsup:

marco.chen: postmortem owner: marco.chen. Action items: (1) infra to bump cert-monitor resources (marco), (2) add early pager rule (emily), (3) runbook add for cert rotation drill (sre_lead).

emily.choi: preparing timeline and attaching cert and logs to the incident. will handoff to night oncall in 40m.

sre_lead: thanks. I'll create a short customer-facing incident summary for the affected customers and for support to reference.

emily.choi: switching rotation now. good job team. :raised_hands:

marco.chen: closing notes: no control-plane code bug, configuration/ops gap in monitoring. Severity to be finalized in postmortem.

emily.choi: closing thread after 30m of stability. will update INC-2026-0518-07 with final severity and action items.
